title: Git-based version control for channels, code templates and config
summary: The most-starred community tool family exists solely to get channels into Git: mirthSync (CLI, 105 stars, plus CI sample, in-admin plugin and VS Code extension), kayyagari/git-ext (server-side JGit with visual diffs), enricogasparini/oie-git-sync (bidirectional sync with per-user branches) and Mysttic MVC. Innovar sells Git-based Version History as a paid BridgeLink plugin.

title: Built-in channel/code template change history with diff and restore
summary: NextGen's Channel History extension is paid (in the Enterprise tier since 4.6); Innovar sells Channel/Version History for BridgeLink; Diridium built simple-channel-history for OIE, and git-ext adds a history tab with object/XML diff. OIE's most-reacted idea issue (#34) asks for channel and code template history; git-ext issues ask for restore and better diffs.

title: Promote channels and code templates between environments with dependency checks
summary: odoodo/Mirth-Migrator is a web tool to transfer channels and code templates between instances with function-dependency analysis, conflict handling and environment comparison; mirthSync and oie-git-sync are used for dev-to-prod promotion; OpenMirth Console advertises channel CI/CD. The engine has no environment promotion concept.

title: Deterministic, diffable, file-per-component channel exports
summary: Channel XML exports reorder elements between saves, breaking Git diffs (connect issue #5004, 10 reactions); mirthSync explodes channels into per-script files and users then asked for monolithic exports back (mirthSync #34, 22 comments); git-ext had to build an object-level diff viewer (objmeld) to make changes readable.

title: Handle channel renames and deletions cleanly in sync/deploy tooling
summary: mirthSync open issues ask to gracefully handle renames and deletions and report pushes that stop when channel groups fail; later versions added orphaned-file detection. Name-keyed file layouts plus ID-keyed engine objects make rename handling a recurring problem.

title: Deploy only changed/new channels after a push
summary: mirthSync users requested deploy-changed/new flags (#78) and force-push for code template libraries and channel groups (#38) so a CI push does not redeploy everything.

title: Find which channels use a code template or library (dependency references)
summary: kayyagari/ct-refs adds a Search Code task to find channels dependent on a code template or library; Mirth-Migrator does function-dependency analysis across channels. The admin shows no usage graph for shared functions.

title: Grep-like search across all channel scripts, templates and global scripts
summary: Diridium's oie-source-code-search, mjtrac/mirth-searchsummary-plugin (cross-channel search plus nested summary) and ct-refs all add code search the Administrator lacks.

title: Native Prometheus metrics endpoint
summary: Three separate Prometheus exporters scrape channel stats via CLI or REST: teamzerolabs/mirth_channel_exporter (Go), vynca/mirth_exporter (Go, via CLI) and feathersct/mirth-prometheus-exporter (Python). Their issues ask for queued counts and support for newer versions, showing the fragility of scraping.

title: Integration with existing NMS tools (Zabbix, PRTG, Nagios-style checks)
summary: Mirthix (cboyer/mirth-zabbix) implements the Zabbix agent protocol as a Mirth channel with low-level discovery of channels and connectors; PRTG-Healthcare provides PRTG sensors. Hospitals want the engine in their existing monitoring stack.

title: Channel-health monitors: inactivity, low volume, queue depth, error rate, anomaly
summary: Built-in alerts only fire on errors; NextGen sells Advanced Alerting (metric, exception and state monitoring, Platinum tier) and Command Center channel analytics; gibson9583/oie-sentinel rebuilt Zabbix-style monitors (inactivity, low volume, anomaly vs baseline, error rate with volume guard, queue depth) for OIE.

title: Alert escalation, scheduling, throttling and storm control
summary: NextGen's paid Advanced Alerting adds escalation/de-escalation, time/day routing, throttling and an alert dashboard; oie-sentinel adds storm control, escalation, dependency suppression and per-monitor severity. Core alerts have none of this.

title: Alert delivery beyond email (webhook, SNS, PagerDuty, channel) and custom template variables
summary: oie-sentinel delivers to email, VM channel, AWS SNS and webhooks; consultancies publish PagerDuty runbooks for Mirth; connect issue #3746 asks for custom variables in alert templates.

title: Single dashboard across many engine instances (fleet monitoring)
summary: NextGen sells Mirth Command Center (4.6+, channel analytics capped at 50/100/200 by tier); the community keeps rebuilding multi-instance monitors: hizni/mirth-node-monitoring (2015), blj83/MirthMonitor, n0rd3r/mirth-monitor, swobspace/mirco, amjohnson87 and enjaytarigan dashboards, OpenMirth Console.

title: Mobile monitoring and push notifications for channel stats
summary: litemikx/PocketMRTH is a React Native app (Google Play) to view stats, start/stop/deploy channels and get push alerts on stat changes, with a companion facade channel because the API is not mobile-friendly.

title: Per-channel log files and channel name in every log line
summary: odoodo/Mirth-MetaAppender replaces Mirth's logging so each channel gets its own log file, errors are accumulated in one file and console lines carry the channel name; it describes itself as eliminating Mirth logging limitations.
quote: eliminates Mirth logging limitations by replacing the logging mechanism

title: View and search server logs from the admin UI without OS access
summary: Diridium's oie-log-viewer lets admins page, search and download mirth.log and rotated archives from the Administrator, because operators often lack shell access to the engine host.

title: Forward audit/event log to SIEM (syslog, Loki, webhook)
summary: greenlogic-pl/oie-audit-forwarder ships every engine event as JSON to Loki, RFC 5424 syslog or a webhook; the core event log is only viewable in the admin or exportable manually.

title: Channel-aware JVM thread viewer and deadlock detection
summary: gibson9583/engine-thread-viewer adds a dashboard tab with live threads correlated to channels/connectors, deadlock detection and jstack-compatible dumps, for diagnosing stuck channels without attaching JVM tools.

title: Telemetry SPI / message lifecycle hooks for tracing (OpenTelemetry-style)
summary: OIE issue #432 asks for a message lifecycle listener SPI in donkey so telemetry plugins can trace messages; today every exporter scrapes aggregate statistics.

title: TLS/SSL on TCP/MLLP connectors without a paid plugin
summary: TLS for TCP/MLLP and certificate-based HTTP/WS/DICOM was only in NextGen's paid SSL Manager, so users built workarounds: tobchen/tc-ssl-plugin, pacmano1/mirthstunnel (stunnel code templates), and finally the NovaMap/Diridium TLS Manager plugin donated to OIE in 2025; Innovar sells an SSL plugin for BridgeLink. Opening a channel with SSL properties without the plugin errors (connect #5230).
quote: For users without the TLS plugin, this code template library uses stunnel

title: Certificate and keystore management UI with mTLS, CRL and OCSP
summary: NextGen SSL Manager (paid) manages certificates for socket connectors; TLS Manager plugin adds mTLS, CRL/OCSP and a web Certificate Manager; Innovar SSL Plugin v3 adds keystore/truststore management and certificate REST APIs.

title: Zero-config HTTPS for HTTP Listener
summary: tonygermano/connect-plugins includes BasicHttpsConfiguration to add zero-config SSL to HTTP Listener connectors, since HTTPS listeners otherwise required the paid SSL Manager or a reverse proxy.

title: LDAP / Active Directory authentication
summary: NextGen's LDAP Authorization extension is paid (Gold tier) and does not map roles without the separate RBAC extension; ChristopherSchultz/mirth-plugins provides a free LDAP authenticator (37 stars), with forks and two OIE LDAP plugins (OpenIntegrationEngine/ldap-plugin, diridium oie-ldap-plugin).

title: Multi-factor authentication (TOTP) for administrators
summary: NextGen sells MFA in the Gold tier; ChristopherSchultz built a free TOTP MFA plugin, OIE hosts an mfa-plugin repo, gibson9583 built oie-totp-plugin, and Innovar markets MFA as an enterprise BridgeLink feature.

title: Single sign-on via OIDC / SAML / cloud identity providers
summary: gibson9583/oie-oidc-auth adds OIDC SSO with JIT users and role mapping from claims (Keycloak, Entra ID, Okta, Cognito); Innovar sells Cognito SSO and OIDC plugins for BridgeLink; OIE issues #171 and #172 request web SSO and OIDC.

title: Role-based access control (users/roles/permissions)
summary: Stock engine lets every authenticated user do everything; RBAC (formerly User Authorization) is a paid NextGen extension (Gold tier) and buggy (export permission not enforced, connect #5372). Diridium built an OIE RBAC plugin, Innovar sells Advanced Access Control, and OIE issue #31 (Users/Roles) is its second most-reacted idea.

title: No phone-home telemetry and no forced registration form on first login
summary: tonygermano/mirth-user-privacy-plugin disables default-on server stats sent to NextGen and bypasses the mandatory first-login registration form added in 4.1, which blocked disposable dev/test servers.
quote: This is an immense burden for developers during testing

title: Browser-based web administrator to replace the Java Swing client
summary: Multiple independent web admins exist: gibson9583 oie-web-client plus oie-web-support-plugin (embedded WAR), Innovar BridgeLink-WebAdmin (claims desktop parity), Nirmitee OpenMirth Console, izorko33/mirth-node; OIE issue #335 asks for backend support. NextGen's own web surface (Command Center) is paid.
quote: Its Java Administrator is 13 years old, universally hated

title: Replacement for the Administrator Launcher / Java Web Start
summary: After Java Web Start died, NextGen's closed-source launcher (MCAL) drew complaints (slow offline launch #5287, cert trust #4379 with 52 comments, firewall SYN-flood reports #4807); community launchers Ballista (20 stars), Diridium launcher, BridgeLink-launcher and slingshot replace it, and their own issues show Java/JAR-signing pain on Mac/Linux.

title: Manage multiple servers / open multiple admin windows at once
summary: Launchers exist largely to store many server connections with status; Ballista #21 asks to launch multiple instances together and connect #5445 (6 reactions) asks for an open-new-window option in the Administrator.

title: Dashboard shows listening ports and channel counts per group
summary: jonbartels/mirth-connect-dashboard-count adds channel counts per group and listening ports for HTTP/TCP/WS connectors, implementing requests from connect issues #5152 and #2115; OIE issue #102 repeats the port column request.

title: Vendor ignores community feature requests
summary: The dashboard-count plugin README quotes Slack users saying GitHub feature requests get as little consideration as Slack posts; the plugin itself was blocked by an unfixed MC bug (#6046). Community plugins became the way to get small UI changes.
quote: So I'm happy to be ignored in either place.

title: Visual graph of channel topology and pipeline stages
summary: NicoPiel/mirthgraph renders channels, sources and destinations as a force graph; OpenMirth Console lays out source-filter-transformer-destinations as a colored pipeline showing which stage failed.

title: Clinical-workflow grouping and failure-location observability
summary: OpenMirth Console buckets channels by clinical interface (ADT, Results, Orders, Pharmacy, Claims) with per-bucket health and shows which connector and stage failed in the last N messages with error payloads inline.

title: Generate human-readable channel documentation (PDF/HTML)
summary: TristanChaput/Mirth-Connect-Channel-Report (PHP) turns channel XML into PDF reports; mirth-searchsummary-plugin generates an accordion HTML summary of all channels.

title: Modern admin conveniences: dark mode, resizable columns, density, product version shown
summary: BridgeLink WebAdmin lists dark mode, resizable/reorderable columns and density as features; Ballista added dark theme and zoom; pujux/mirth-version-plugin exists only to show the product version in the GUI.

title: Step-through JavaScript debugger for channel scripts
summary: gibson9583/oie-debugger adds breakpoints, stepping, variable/map/message inspection, watches and send-test-message from the web admin; previously users debugged with logger.info.

title: Unit-test channel scripts outside the engine and in CI
summary: Mirth-Jest-Framework runs transformer logic in Jest via external JS files, tonygermano/connect-vscode emulates a pseudo-Mirth Rhino environment, mirthsync-ci shows GitHub Actions CI, cervical-dev/create-mirth-dev and feathersct/mirth-vscode-js-runner run scripts locally.

title: Golden-file regression tests for transformations (input message vs expected output)
summary: gjergjsheldija/mirth-tools spins up a clean OIE in Docker, deploys a channel via API and compares HL7 inputs to expected JSON with ignore markers, emitting JUnit for Jira; loading the channel is still manual.

title: IDE development with IntelliSense and typings for the scripting API
summary: Saga's MirthSync for VS Code (274 installs) adds IntelliSense for Mirth APIs and tree views; mirth-connect-types publishes TypeScript definitions for the Rhino user API; Red Fern's Mirth Connect Explorer is another VS Code attempt. The built-in editor has weak code assist (OIE #327).

title: One-command throwaway local engine for development
summary: MirthSync for VS Code ships a one-command Docker Compose stack (OIE plus Postgres) for offline testing; mirth-tools and many docker repos exist to stand up disposable engines.

title: Modern JavaScript engine instead of Rhino
summary: connect issue #4409 'Rhino should be retired in favor of V8' is the most-reacted issue in its search set (13); OIE #327 shows code assist breaking on newer Java syntax. Utility libraries like Phantom.js exist partly to paper over Rhino-era gaps.

title: Script editor freezes and lags when editing transformers
summary: connect issue #4333 (7 reactions, 12 comments) reports the Administrator freezing while editing JavaScript in a transformer; it is a driver for editing in VS Code via mirthSync instead.

title: Richer standard library for scripting (maps, dates, JSON, XML, strings)
summary: Users publish helper libraries and snippet collections to fill gaps: Phantom.js (104 functions, 284 tests), pacmano1/Mirth-Snippets, MichaelLeeHobbs/mmc, thorst/My-Mirth-Code, Nirmitee cookbook, and NextGen's own connect-examples code templates.

title: Python for filters, transformers and connectors
summary: gibson9583/oie-python-toolkit offers community Python filters, transformers, reader/writer connectors and managed environments for OIE.

title: PDF generation and image manipulation in channels
summary: JakeCroz1/Mirth-Connect-PDF-Generator documents how to generate PDFs with Java libraries; OIE issue #42 asks for image manipulation and PDF support built in.

title: Cached lookups against external databases
summary: Diridium's oie-cache-manager adds Guava-backed key-value caches over external DBs with HikariCP pooling, an admin UI and inspector, used as $g('zip2').lookup(zip); per-message DB queries otherwise cause connection storms.

title: Code/terminology mapping tables (LOINC, SNOMED crosswalks)
summary: Innovar sells a Dynamic Lookup Gateway code-mapping engine for LOINC/SNOMED lookups in BridgeLink Enterprise; stock engines leave mapping tables to code templates or external DBs.

title: Plugin/content marketplace inside the admin
summary: gibson9583/oie-community-store and oie-community-catalog add a HACS-style store to discover, sha256-verify and install extensions, channels and code templates; previously plugins were found via awesome-mirth lists and Slack.

title: Library of ready-made example channels and recipes
summary: Example repos are among the most-starred in the ecosystem: nextgenhealthcare/connect-examples (114), fhir-example-channels (53), MirthConnectExamples (35), cabolabs-mirth (24), marlycormar examples (23), koratech examples (16).

title: Training material and tutorials are thin
summary: Users build their own courses and workshop repos: Rohit-Shines/Mirth YouTube classes (20), MirthConnectWorkshop (10), Mirth-Learning-Project, mirthCasts podcast, Chinese-language docs (wanghaisheng) and a localized 3.9 build.

title: Localization of the admin UI (non-English)
summary: schic/MirthConnect-3.9.0 is a self-built Chinese-localized Mirth distribution and wanghaisheng maintains Chinese docs; the product ships English only.

title: Plugin development is hard (SDK, Maven deps, signing)
summary: kpalang/mirth-plugin-guide (44), mirth-sample-plugin (28) and two mirth-plugin-maven-plugins (15, 10) exist because there is no official SDK; READMEs describe copying engine jars into lib folders, a public Maven mirror that lacks artifacts, and the client-plugin signing tango. OIE added a plugin guide (#238).

title: Plugins break or are pinned to exact engine versions
summary: Community plugins state narrow compatibility: searchsummary only for 4.3.0, ct-refs for 3.9-3.10, tc-ssl for 4.0.1, OIE plugins limited to 4.6/4.7 with separate builds; a ServerPlugin without a type interface silently never starts (OIE #398). No stable plugin API contract.

title: Downloading entitled commercial plugins is cumbersome
summary: rogin/MirthPluginDownloader scrapes NextGen's Salesforce-backed portal to bulk-download commercial plugins and their guides by version and warns when your support level bars a plugin.

title: Essential features paywalled (SSL, history, LDAP, RBAC, MFA, clustering, alerting)
summary: NextGen sells extensions only inside per-server annual licenses: Enterprise (SSL Manager, Channel History, Message Generator, Enhancement Bundle), Gold (+MFA, RBAC, LDAP, FHIR R5, Interop Suite, Email OAuth, Serial, ASTM) and Platinum (+Advanced Clustering, Advanced Alerting). Each became a community plugin target once the source closed.

title: Open-source Mirth ended at 4.5.2; users need a maintained open engine
summary: NextGen moved 4.6 (announced 2025-03-19) to a closed proprietary license; the community forked Open Integration Engine (243 stars, 35K Docker pulls, now an Eclipse project) and Innovar forked BridgeLink (144K Docker pulls, partly commercial). Several plugin authors stopped updates on Mirth.
quote: disappointing to see the open-source version discontinued

title: New engines rewritten from scratch as Mirth alternatives
summary: Independent rewrites appeared after the license change: BioDream perfuse (single static binary, HL7/FHIR/DICOM/X12/CDA, Apache-2.0), MessageFoundry, a TypeScript port of Mirth, and 'Mirth Connect Next Gen'.

title: Opaque per-server pricing; non-prod, DR and cluster licensing unclear
summary: NextGen publishes no prices (flat annual fee per production server, quote only); a consultancy TCO analysis warns that test/staging/DR/cluster node licensing is unstated and plugin add-ons were estimated at $5K-15K/yr.

title: Paid monitoring portal unavailable in EU/UK and capped by channel count
summary: Mirth Command Center, bundled with all 4.6 licenses, is not available in the EU or UK and caps channel analytics at 50/100/200 channels by tier, so it is not a full monitoring answer.

title: Free tier for research/non-profit use
summary: NextGen created a complimentary 'Mirth Connect for Research' license for approved research studies at non-profits, an admission that the paid model excludes small users.

title: Vendor-neutral paid support, hosting and managed operations
summary: A services market fills support gaps: Saga IT sells managed Mirth/OIE operations on AWS Marketplace, Innovar sells hosting and support tiers, BrightCodeCompany builds custom plugins, Meditecs sells ASTM and digital-pathology extensions, Taction/CapMinds/Chetu sell development; rogin/mirth-consulting and OIE's vendors repo list them.

title: Maintained official container images for current versions
summary: nextgenhealthcare/connect has 15.8M Docker Hub pulls but its newest public tag is 4.5.2 (last pushed 2024-10); community images (brandonstevens 471K pulls, fabrom 37 stars, jamesdempsey 17) and OIE/BridgeLink images fill in, and OIE engine-docker issues ask for automated builds, 4.7.0 tags and a README on Docker Hub.

title: Configure the engine from environment variables (12-factor containers)
summary: jonbartels/bootermcgooter sets server/environment name from env vars at startup because they live only in the DB; connect-docker issues report JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS and log4j handling in entrypoint.sh, OIE engine-docker issues report VMOPTIONS overrides and sed escaping breaking passwords, and OIE #173 asks to set plugin properties from mirth.properties.

title: Start a container with pre-configured channels (config as code)
summary: connect-docker #9 asks how to start with pre-configured channels; users preload DBs with SQL, run mirthSync after boot, or bake channel imports into entrypoints. No declarative bootstrap exists.

title: ARM / Apple Silicon support for images and launcher
summary: connect-docker #15 (Mirth does not start on Apple M1) remains open; Ballista issues report unresponsive launches on M4 Macs and 'damaged' aarch64 DMGs.

title: Kubernetes / Helm / IaC deployment support
summary: Only abandoned proofs of concept exist: hiddehs/nextgen-connect-chart (Helm, 6 forks), mistrasteos mirth-kubernetes and Ansible role, a Chef cookbook; AWS published a CDK sample on ECS Fargate with Aurora. No maintained Helm chart or Terraform provider was found.

title: Container image CVEs and published SBOM
summary: connect-docker issues report OpenSSL and base-image CVEs and ask to switch base images; connect #5852 (12 reactions) asks NextGen to publish an SBOM and #4990 lists critical CVEs from an Anchore scan.

title: Unpatched pre-auth RCE and weak stored password hashes in old installs
summary: Public exploit repos for CVE-2023-43208 (XStream deserialization pre-auth RCE before 4.4.1) and password-hash cracking scripts for PERSON_PASSWORD keep appearing, reflecting many installs stuck on old versions.

title: Configurable password policy and non-privileged install
summary: connect #6098 asks for password configuration and security controls; #4842 asks the installer to require a named, non-privileged service user.

title: Backup of channels and full configuration on a schedule
summary: At least eight small backup tools/channels exist (odoodo/Mirth-Backup, MCC-Backup-Channel, MCC-SIDEKICK, velumani backup, GopiPradeepReddy MirthBackup, yearly channel archives); connect #5654 asks for granular backup/restore config.

title: Active/active clustering with automatic message takeover
summary: HA requires NextGen's Advanced Clustering (Platinum only) on a shared database; Innovar sells auto-scaling/HA in BridgeLink Enterprise; OIE issue #41 requests HA; without the plugin users disable polling auto-start per node by hand to avoid duplicates.

title: Paid clustering is buggy and conflicts with other paid extensions
summary: Open connect issues: Advanced Clustering breaks Advanced Alerting (#5415), generates DB errors (#5246), selects the wrong instance IP (#5272); users ask for per-channel polling control (#6190) and to see which node sent data (#5741).

title: Cloud reference deployments (AWS/Azure HA) and marketplace images
summary: aws-samples/mirth-connect-on-aws (CDK, ECS Fargate, Aurora), NextGen Azure/AWS deployment guides, Innovar BridgeLink AMIs billed hourly and Saga managed AWS operations show demand for turnkey cloud deployment.

title: TCP sender with multiple endpoints, failover and sticky routing
summary: MichaelLeeHobbs/oie-tcp-multi-sender adds failover across HA receiver replicas; pixelreverb/mirth-connect-tcp-broker is a PoC TCP connection broker.

title: Engine-managed SSH tunnels / reach endpoints behind NAT
summary: Diridium's oie-ssh-tunnel-manager keeps local and reverse SSH forwards alive from the admin (addressing OIE #357) instead of systemd ssh processes; Saga's OpenShare lets dev tools reach servers behind NAT without VPN.

title: Serial (RS-232) connector for devices
summary: The Serial Connector is a paid NextGen extension (Gold tier); OIE users run port servers to convert serial to Ethernet and hand-roll JavaScript listeners.

title: ASTM E1381/E1394 lab instrument support
summary: ASTM transmission mode and data type are paid NextGen extensions (Gold); OIE users share JavaScript-source ASTM workarounds for Sysmex, Clinitek, Sofia analyzers, Meditecs sells ASTM extensions, and kpalang built a custom transmission mode for a Cube 30 analyzer.

title: IHE profiles (PIX/PDQ/XDS.b/XCA/XCPD) for HIE onboarding
summary: NextGen's Interoperability Connector Suite (paid, Gold tier, since 3.6) supplies listeners/senders for PIX v2/v3, PDQ, XDS.b, XCA and XCPD to kickstart eHealth Exchange onboarding; no open-source equivalent was found.

title: Email reader with OAuth2 (Microsoft 365 / Google)
summary: After providers retired basic auth, OAuth email reading is only in a paid NextGen extension (Email Reader with OAuth, Gold tier).

title: Direct secure messaging / Secure Email
summary: NextGen lists a Secure Email extension and sells Mirth Mail (now NextGen Direct Messaging) separately for Direct-protocol exchange.

title: Cloud queue and messaging connectors (SQS, RabbitMQ)
summary: gibson9583/sqs-source-connector polls AWS SQS; Saga's MirthHL72SQS sends HL7 to SQS; ABI thesis project built a RabbitMQ microservice for Mirth; OIE #521 asks for a WebSocket client connector.

title: Cloud healthcare API connectivity (Google Healthcare API, AWS HealthLake, Cosmos DB)
summary: healthcare-integrations/Google-Cloud-NextGen-Connect, aws-samples' SigV4 jar for HealthLake, and sledhealth's Cosmos DB channel all exist because cloud auth (OAuth service accounts, SigV4) needs custom Java in custom-lib.

title: HTTP sender: custom methods and header limits
summary: OIE #555 asks for a custom HTTP method field (fixed list today) and #479 a configurable response header size limit on HTTP Listener.

title: First-class FHIR connector, data type and profile validation (R4/R5)
summary: NextGen's FHIR Connector is an extension and FHIR R5 is in the paid Gold tier; matthydehoog built a FHIR data type for OIE with HAPI validation against custom profiles, Yeovil Hospital published FHIR listener channels, and fhir-example-channels (53 stars) is a top repo.

title: Built-in HL7v2-to-FHIR mapping
summary: Many repos hand-build v2-to-FHIR channels (Symbol-Health bridge, InfoGleam PoCs, maternity pipeline, ORM pipeline) and Microsoft's FHIR Converter VS Code extension has about 9.7K installs; no engine ships maintained v2-to-FHIR maps.

title: HL7 test message generator and interface simulator
summary: NextGen's Message Generator is paid (Enterprise tier); Mirthquake (Python, send/receive simulator with ACK control), Saga mirth-loadtest, 2020-Healthcare-Data-Simulators and HL7 Inspector fill the gap.

title: Load and throughput testing over MLLP
summary: avisi/jmeter-mllp-tcpclient (26 stars, 22 forks) adds MLLP to JMeter; Mirthquake runs paced concurrent loads; Saga's mirth-loadtest generates randomized HL7/DICOM load.

title: HL7 message viewing and editing tooling
summary: HL7 editor extensions are popular independent of any engine: VS Code hl7tools (~31K installs), HL7 Language Support (~18K), hl7-tester, plus HL7 Inspector; engine message browsers are not where people inspect messages.

title: Search and export messages across multiple channels
summary: Cross-channel message search and export is in NextGen's paid Enhancement Bundle (Enterprise tier); the stock message browser is per-channel.

title: Saved searches and indexed custom metadata in message browser
summary: connect #2667 asks to save message browser searches; #4320 (5 reactions) asks to index custom metadata columns so searches are fast; #6255 asks for granular storage settings.

title: Official API client SDKs (Python, .NET, PowerShell, Node)
summary: Users wrote at least nine REST clients: PS_Mirth (13), mirthpy (10), mirth-api Node (11), oie-web-client (11), MirthDotNet (5), python-mirth-client (5), feathersct C# (3), MirthConnectFx (2), mirth-node (2), plus a REDCap client.

title: Supported scriptable CLI
summary: connect-docker #5 asks why mccommand was removed from the image; vynca's exporter depends on the Java CLI jar; mirthSync became the de facto CLI for pull/push/deploy.

title: REST API quirks (XML-first, X-Requested-With, JSON type coercion)
summary: Exporter authors had to add an X-Requested-With header (teamzerolabs #4); OIE #568 reports the REST API's JSON converting numeric-looking strings to numbers, booleans and null; OIE #271 proposes splitting API from application.

title: AI assistance and MCP access for channel development and operations
summary: Innovar sells an OpenAI plugin (debugging, optimization, sample data) for BridgeLink Enterprise; community built mirth_connect_mcp (MCP server over the REST API), mirth-connect-skills and a Claude plugin for OIE.

title: ONC Cures certification support
summary: NextGen sells a Cures Extension (add-on to Gold/Platinum, 4.5+) that, with RBAC and Enhancement Bundle, is required for ONC Health IT Cures certification criteria (authentication, audit, trusted connection).

title: Turnkey hardened appliance with SNMP monitoring
summary: NextGen sold Mirth Appliances (hardware/virtual) bundling Connect with Advanced Clustering, SNMP component monitoring and managed updates; cloud marketplace images now play that role.

title: Migration between engine versions and forks (Mirth to OIE/BridgeLink)
summary: Innovar publishes a migrate-from-Mirth guide, Mirth-Migrator supports Mirth, OIE and BridgeLink, and OIE #211 asks to keep Migratable converters current every release so old exports keep importing.

title: DICOM metadata extraction to a queryable database
summary: sglanger/ddw is a Mirth channel plus PostgreSQL schema for DICOM data mining; kayyagari/coconut loads CSV via DuckDB with dynamic Java models, both bolting analytics storage onto the engine.
